# Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No.1) Bill 2026 [and related Bill]
## Schedule 4: Standard deduction for work-related expenses
### Background and policy development
31). In April 2025, during the federal election campaign, the Government [announced](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22media%2Fpressrel%2F10257274%22) the $1,000 instant tax deduction as an alternative to claiming work‑related expenses, from 1 July 2026. The Parliamentary Budget Office (PBO) [released a costing estimate](https://www.pbo.gov.au/elections/2025-general-election/2025-election-commitments-costings/1000-instant-tax-deduction-work-related-expenses) for the measure.

The 2026–27 Budget [confirmed](https://budget.gov.au/content/bp2/download/bp2_2026-27.pdf) the measure (p. 19), with an [estimated](https://ministers.treasury.gov.au/ministers/jim-chalmers-2022/media-releases/1000-instant-tax-deduction-deliver-lower-simpler-taxes) **6.2 million workers** ( **42% of taxpayers**) benefiting, with an average **saving of $205.**

## Key issues and provisions
**Items 1** and **3** of Schedule 1 to the Bill introduce a new maximum $1,000 standard deduction for work-related expenses.
